# GroundField

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/ground_field.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/ground_field.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

The world's ground as a density function: what the kinematic walk, the routes and the animals' gaits plant feet on, with no collider.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint64_t` | counts changes of the ground (PlaneField::setTilt): planted feet are fitted again (default 0) |

## Notes

Stored as std::shared_ptr<GroundField> (abstract class: density(p) > 0 inside, below(from, distance), top(x, z), height(x, z, from_y, fallback)). Implementations: PlaneField (tilted plane: origin, pitch, roll, normal) set by GroundPlane, TerrainField (marching cubes of the TerrainGenerator's samples, lazily meshed blocks of 4^3 cubes, at most 4096 cached) set by GroundTerrain. groundField(reg) emplaces a level PlaneField at y = 0 when none exists. AgentFactory, AnimalFactory, herds, steering and gait scenes copy the pointer in init. Not thread safe (TerrainField's cache is mutable).

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md)**
  - Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
  - Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.
- **[AnimalLineup](../systems/AnimalLineup.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species, the origin, and each animal's place, height and clip count.
- **[AnimalWalkers](../systems/AnimalWalkers.md)**
  - Creates one entity per animal in init.
  - Logs missing species or walks and each animal's clip, speed, radius and place.
  - Queries the ground field per animal per tick.
- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
- **[GroundPlane](../systems/GroundPlane.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GroundTerrain](../systems/GroundTerrain.md)**
  - Later queries of the field (by other systems) sample and mesh blocks of 4^3 cubes on the CPU and cache up to 4096 of them.
- **[HerdWatch](../systems/HerdWatch.md)**
  - Moves the desktop camera every tick once it has a herd.
  - Logs the herd it chose.
  - Queries the ground field up to ten times a tick.
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[MountSpawn](../systems/MountSpawn.md)**
  - Creates `count` animal entities in init.
  - Logs a warning `MountSpawn : no animal <species> in the library` and makes nothing when the species is missing.
  - Without a GroundField but with a terrain, builds a TerrainField (with its own MarchingCubes) for the ground heights.
- **[SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md)**
  - Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
  - Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.
